description: Copies media into the signed-in user's library for use in generate_* tools. When to use: user provides a public https URL or you reuse a completed image generation. Cost: free (rate limited). Provide exactly one of url or generation_id. Returns: upload_id and metadata. Consumes bandwidth only; may write upload records.

generation_id.description: Id of a completed image generation owned by the user to copy.
generation_id.title: Generation Id

url.description: Public https URL of an image or video to copy.
url.title: Url

name: import_media_from_url
title: Import media from URL
